First we need to perform the transformation of this voltage source to current source and once we do so we will have a current source here and this resistor will come in parallel with the current source. Is it forward biased or is it reverse biased and we know that the diode will be forward biased when the P side will be subjected to the higher potential than the N side and we don't have to worry about the barrier potential as the diode is ideal in nature. Now focus on P side it is connected to one ohm resistor and then to the positive terminal of 5 volt source.
